dedupe_keys.name: identifying best low d o f surrogate models for complex structures by combining fem and ml

description: Identifying best low-d.o.f. surrogate models for complex structures by combining FEM and ML is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Shitao Shi, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (illinois.edu). The use of high-fidelity structural models for the assessment of the effects of an earthquake on a region are too computationally demanding, especially if uncertainties in design, construction, etc. are considered. Thus, surrogate models that have many fewer degrees-of-freedom, greatly reduced computational demands, and provide accurate simulation of essential behavior, are required. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Building Structures; Finite Element; Machine Learning; Surrogate Models. Published 2022-08-05. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
